title: instrument
description: Reference dimension — one tradable symbol in the universe. See data-dictionary.md §1.1 and data-model.md §5.1.

symbol.description: The stock/ETF symbol. Natural key. Every mention.ticker must exist here (extractor validates against the whitelist).

name.description: Raw vendor (UPPERCASE) company/fund name, e.g. BROADCOM INC. COMMON STOCK. The display layer prettifies it.

asset_class.description: Security class; lets ETFs/leveraged products be treated differently (e.g. liquidity filters for STEALTH).

is_etf.description: True for funds; used to down-weight leveraged-ETF screener noise.

is_ambiguous.description: A real ticker that is also a common English word (e.g. DRAM, IT, ON). When true, a bare mention is counted only with trading context.

listing_status.description: Tradability state; refreshed weekly from the vendor asset list.

first_seen.description: When the symbol first entered the universe (bookkeeping).

last_refreshed.description: When this row was last reconciled against the vendor asset list (bookkeeping).
